issues.detail: Covers the happy path and auth failure but gives little guidance on error scenarios such as failed uploads, webhook/callback failures in local development, missing or invalid UPLOADTHING_TOKEN, or file-type/size rejection handling beyond a brief mention.
The two examples are short prose descriptions that refer back to earlier steps instead of showing full runnable input and output, so they are simplistic.

scenarios.name: avatar-uploader-with-auth
scenarios.rationale: Both responses cover every rubric item (2MB/1-file image route, middleware that throws UploadThingError and returns userId, file.ufsUrl saved in onUploadComplete, GET/POST from createRouteHandler, OurFileRouter exported), and B scores marginally higher for its extra notes on callback reliability, old-image cleanup and the older-version URL field.

scenarios.name: pdf-dropzone-typed-components
scenarios.rationale: Both configure a PDF-only maxFileCount 5 route with a typed UploadDropzone, but B states the Tailwind v4 import and that withUt is v3-only and includes the optional NextSSRPlugin with extractRouterConfig, while A gives the v4 import plus an @source line, never mentions withUt and omits NextSSRPlugin.

scenarios.name: migrate-token-and-manage-files-server-side
scenarios.rationale: A matches the rubric closely: UPLOADTHING_TOKEN kept server-only, UTApi from uploadthing/server, deleteFiles with an array of keys, uploadFiles with a File, and ufsUrl. B also covers these but passes a bare string to deleteFiles in its main snippet instead of an array, and it uses UTFile rather than a File object, though it is a File subclass.
